name: fxf_s19_power_tab
doc: Stands in for saves/field_re/s19_power_tab.state, the reference's own provenance from a recipe-made start: the ROM's own loader (--teleport 19 45 33 3, method jmp, 120 frames) from the candy stand with Marle following (fair_candy, in place of the candy-shop capture) puts the party in Guardia Forest (loc 013) beside the Power Tab's sparkle (obj41, tile 46,33), the lead facing right.
